words.definition: A place that is a popular destination for vacations or recreation.
words.example: They spent their summer vacation at a beautiful beach resort.

words.definition: A place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose.
words.example: The new sports facility includes an Olympic-sized swimming pool.

words.definition: Made, done, happening, or chosen without method or conscious decision.
words.example: The teacher called on students in a completely random order.

words.definition: An official document attesting to a certain fact, in particular, the level of achievement in a course of study or training.
words.example: She proudly framed her university degree certificate and hung it on the wall.

words.definition: A head of a government department or a member of the clergy.
words.example: The prime minister gave an important speech to the nation.

words.definition: The action or process of moving or being moved.
words.example: The gentle rocking motion of the boat quickly put the baby to sleep.

words.definition: A popular trend, especially in styles of dress and ornament or manners of behavior.
words.example: She has always been very interested in the latest clothing fashion.

words.definition: An instrument or device used for observing, checking, or keeping a continuous record of a process or quantity.
words.example: He stared at the computer monitor for hours while finishing his project.

words.definition: The action or activity of buying and selling goods and services.
words.example: The historic port city is famous for its busy spice trading.

words.definition: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
words.example: We hiked through the dense, green forest for three hours.

words.definition: Belonging to or associated with which person.
words.example: Do you know whose jacket this is left on the chair?

words.definition: The extent to which something deals with or applies to something else, especially in insurance or journalism.
words.example: The local news provided extensive live coverage of the heavy snowstorm.

words.definition: Two individuals of the same sort considered together.
words.example: I will be ready to leave in just a couple of minutes.

words.definition: Present participle of give; freely transferring the possession of something to someone.
words.example: She is known for giving her time to help those in need.

words.definition: A possibility of something happening.
words.example: This is your last chance to buy tickets for the concert.

words.definition: The faculty or state of being able to see.
words.example: The eagle has incredibly sharp vision for hunting small prey.

words.definition: A solid or hollow spherical or egg-shaped object that is kicked, thrown, or hit in a game.
words.example: The children had fun throwing a small red ball back and forth.

words.definition: An end or final part of something, especially a period of time, an activity, or a story.
words.example: The movie had a very surprising and dramatic ending.

words.definition: Give one's attention to a sound.
words.example: I love to listen to relaxing music when I am studying.

words.definition: Talk about something with another person or group of people in order to reach a decision or exchange ideas.
words.example: We need to discuss the new project details at our next meeting.

words.definition: Consent to receive a thing offered.
words.example: She was thrilled to accept the generous job offer from the company.

words.definition: Without clothes; without covering or addition.
words.example: The trees were completely naked after losing all their leaves in winter.

words.definition: The object of a person's ambition or effort; an aim or desired result.
words.example: His main goal is to graduate from college with top honors.

words.definition: Accomplishing an aim or purpose.
words.example: The charity event was incredibly successful and raised thousands of dollars.

words.definition: Past and past participle of sell; give or hand over something in exchange for money.
words.example: The popular bakery completely sold out of fresh bread by noon.

words.definition: The perceptible natural movement of the air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.
words.example: The strong wind blew all of the loose leaves across the yard.

words.definition: Relating to the observation and treatment of actual patients rather than theoretical or laboratory studies.
words.example: The new medication is currently undergoing extensive clinical trials.

words.definition: A set of circumstances in which one finds oneself; a state of affairs.
words.example: We must carefully analyze the financial situation before making any decisions.

words.definition: At or to a high degree or level.
words.example: The new restaurant in town comes highly recommended by many critics.

words.definition: Come into sight; become visible or noticeable, typically without visible agent or apparent cause.
words.example: The dark clouds made the sky appear very stormy and threatening.

words.definition: A serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
words.example: In case of a medical emergency, you should call the hospital immediately.

words.definition: Plural form of life; the condition that distinguishes animals and plants from inorganic matter.
words.example: The brave firefighters saved many lives during the massive forest fire.

words.definition: A system of money in general use in a particular country.
words.example: You will need to exchange your currency before traveling to Japan.

words.definition: A material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.
words.example: He bought a high-quality leather wallet to give as a birthday gift.

words.definition: Cause something to occur in a particular way; be the decisive factor in.
words.example: The size of your living room will determine which couch you should buy.

words.definition: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object.
words.example: The outside temperature dropped below freezing during the cold winter night.

words.definition: The inner surface of the hand between the wrist and fingers.
words.example: She held the tiny, fragile bird gently in the palm of her hand.

words.definition: A person receiving or registered to receive medical treatment.
words.example: The doctor asked the patient to sit quietly while taking their blood pressure.

words.definition: Existing in fact; typically as contrasted with what was intended, expected, or believed.
words.example: The actual cost of the repairs was much higher than the original estimate.

words.definition: Of or concerning history; concerning past events.
words.example: The town has many historical buildings that are hundreds of years old.

words.definition: Hard solid nonmetallic mineral matter of which rock is made, especially as a building material.
words.example: The ancient castle was built entirely out of large blocks of stone.

words.definition: Make a quick short movement up and down.
words.example: We watched the small boat bob up and down on the gentle waves.

words.definition: The activity of buying and selling, especially on a large scale.
words.example: The city became a wealthy center for international trade and commerce.

words.definition: Used to express uncertainty or possibility.
words.example: Perhaps we should wait until the heavy rain stops before we leave.

words.definition: Needing much effort or skill to accomplish, deal with, or understand.
words.example: The math exam was extremely difficult, but I think I passed.

words.definition: Based on or characterized by the methods and principles of science.
words.example: The university conducted a major scientific study on climate change.

words.definition: An artificial body placed in orbit around the earth or moon or another planet in order to collect information or for communication.
words.example: The weather satellite tracks massive storms moving across the ocean.

words.definition: Of a suitable quality, standard, or type to meet the required purpose.
words.example: He runs five miles every morning to make sure he stays physically fit.

words.definition: A group of houses and associated buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area.
words.example: They spent the summer living in a small, quiet fishing village.

words.definition: A person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.
words.example: Although he is an amateur photographer, his pictures are absolutely stunning.

words.definition: Past and past participle of meet; came into the presence or company of someone by chance or arrangement.
words.example: I met my very best friend during our first year of university.

words.definition: Physical suffering or discomfort caused by illness or injury.
words.example: She felt a sharp pain in her ankle after tripping on the stairs.

words.definition: So as to give special emphasis to a point; specifically or especially.
words.example: I am not particularly fond of spicy food, but I will eat it.

words.definition: A hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds (coffee beans) of a tropical shrub.
words.example: He drinks a large cup of black coffee every single morning.

words.definition: A person who makes a purchase.
words.example: They finally found a buyer for their old car after weeks of waiting.

words.definition: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.
words.example: The museum hosts many events to celebrate the city's rich cultural diversity.

words.definition: A common male name, often a short form of Steven or Stephen.
words.example: My friend Steve is organizing the neighborhood block party this weekend.

words.definition: Without difficulty or effort.
words.example: She won the race easily, crossing the finish line far ahead of the others.

words.definition: By word of mouth; spoken rather than written.
words.example: The history class requires a final oral presentation instead of a written exam.

words.definition: A shallow place in a river or stream allowing one to walk or drive across.
words.example: We slowly drove the truck across the shallow ford in the river.

words.definition: A large printed picture used for decoration.
words.example: He hung a vintage movie poster on the wall of his bedroom.

words.definition: The outside limit of an object, area, or surface.
words.example: Please do not place your glass so close to the edge of the table.

words.definition: Designed to be practical and useful, rather than attractive.
words.example: The kitchen has a very simple but highly functional design.

words.definition: The part of a plant which attaches it to the ground or to a support, typically underground, conveying water and nourishment to the rest of the plant.
words.example: The strong wind pulled the old tree completely out by its root.

words.definition: Frozen water, a brittle transparent crystalline solid.
words.example: I would like a tall glass of water with plenty of ice.

words.definition: Of a color intermediate between red and white, as of coral or salmon.
words.example: The sky turned a beautiful shade of pink during the evening sunset.

words.definition: An even distribution of weight enabling someone or something to remain upright and steady.
words.example: The gymnast showed incredible balance as she walked across the thin beam.

words.definition: Successfully complete an academic degree, course of training, or high school.
words.example: She plans to graduate from the university with a degree in biology.

words.definition: The firing of a gun or cannon.
words.example: We heard a loud shot ring out from the dense woods.

words.definition: The art or practice of designing and constructing buildings.
words.example: The city is famous for its stunning modern and classical architecture.

words.definition: Existing or occurring at the beginning.
words.example: My initial reaction was surprise, but then I felt very happy.

words.definition: A small piece of paper, fabric, plastic, or similar material attached to an object and giving information about it.
words.example: Please read the washing label on the shirt before putting it in the machine.

words.definition: The process of using one's mind to consider or reason about something.
words.example: His quick thinking saved the project from becoming a complete failure.

words.definition: Put forward someone or something with approval as being suitable for a particular purpose or role.
words.example: I highly recommend the new seafood restaurant down by the harbor.

words.definition: A general law, rule, principle, or criterion by which something is judged.
words.example: The new film breaks almost every accepted canon of traditional storytelling.

words.definition: A collection of people, countries, or groups that combine for a particular purpose, typically mutual protection or cooperation.
words.example: The local football league is organizing a charity tournament next month.

words.definition: Use or expend carelessly, extravagantly, or to no purpose.
words.example: We should not waste any time getting started on this important task.

words.definition: A period of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.
words.example: I will be ready to leave in exactly one minute.

words.definition: A large motor vehicle carrying passengers by road, typically one serving the public on a fixed route and for a fare.
words.example: She rides the city bus to work every single morning.

words.definition: A person or thing that provides something.
words.example: They are looking for a new internet service provider for their office.

words.definition: Available to be chosen but not obligatory.
words.example: The final essay question on the exam is completely optional.

words.definition: A book or electronic resource that lists the words of a language and gives their meaning, or gives the equivalent words in a different language.
words.example: If you don't know the word, look it up in the dictionary.

words.definition: Of or at a low or relatively low temperature, especially when compared with the human body.
words.example: The winter air was incredibly cold, making everyone shiver.

words.definition: The making of articles on a large scale using machinery; industrial production.
words.example: The city has a long history of automobile manufacturing and assembly.

words.definition: A separate seat for one person, typically with a back and four legs.
words.example: He sat down in a comfortable wooden chair by the warm fire.

words.definition: The activity of catching fish, either for food or as a sport.
words.example: They woke up early on Sunday morning to go fishing at the lake.

words.definition: A vigorous or determined attempt.
words.example: She put a lot of effort into making sure the party was perfect.

words.definition: A distinct period or stage in a process of change or forming part of something's development.
words.example: The construction project is finally entering its final phase this week.

words.definition: A container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.
words.example: She carried a large reusable bag to the grocery store.

words.definition: The faculty or activity of imagining things, especially things that are impossible or improbable.
words.example: He prefers reading epic fantasy novels filled with magic and dragons.

words.definition: A machine, especially one powered by electricity or internal combustion, that supplies motive power for a vehicle or for some other device with moving parts.
words.example: The boat has a powerful electric motor that runs very quietly.

words.definition: A university academic of the highest rank; an academic teacher or researcher.
words.example: The university professor delivered a fascinating lecture on ancient history.

words.definition: The circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea, and in terms of which it can be fully understood.
words.example: You need to understand the historical context to appreciate the poem fully.

words.definition: Place or fix equipment or machinery in position ready for use.
words.example: The technicians will arrive tomorrow morning to install the new air conditioner.

words.definition: A garment for the upper body made of cotton or a similar fabric, with a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.
words.example: He wore a crisp white shirt and a blue tie to the interview.

words.definition: Clothing, especially outer garments.
words.example: The store sells high-quality outdoor apparel designed for extreme weather.

words.definition: In most cases; usually.
words.example: I generally wake up around seven in the morning during the week.

words.definition: Without interruption; ongoing.
words.example: The company relies on the continued support of its loyal customers.

words.definition: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.
words.example: He dropped a heavy box right on his left foot.

words.definition: A large body of matter with no definite shape.
words.example: A huge, dark mass of clouds gathered quickly on the horizon.
